text: In 2012, the Brevard public library removed nineteen copies of E L James's Fifty Shades of Grey from circulation on the ground that it was "semi-pornographic"; the Brevard County Library System later decided to return the book to its shelves in response to public demand and after review. In January 2013, a judge ruled that bookstores in Macaé must either remove the Fifty Shades of Grey series from their shelves or ensure that the books are wrapped and placed out of the reach of minors. In Malaysia, the Home Ministry banned the printing, publication and ownership of the trilogy under the Printing Presses and Publications Act 1984, in an order dated February 24, citing morality.
meta_description: Fifty Shades of Grey by E L James: removed by a public library in 2012, restricted by a court in 2013 and banned in Malaysia on grounds of morality.
